headline: Kestrel Industries signs multi-year framework agreement
body: Kestrel Industries announced a framework agreement with a large manufacturer. Terms were not disclosed, and the company expects stable volumes through the contract period.

headline: Kestrel Industries publishes annual sustainability report
body: Kestrel Industries released its annual sustainability report covering energy use and waste reduction targets. The report was prepared in line with standard reporting guidelines.

headline: Kestrel Industries wins quality award from industry association
body: Kestrel Industries received a supplier excellence award citing low defect rates and strong on-time delivery. The company plans to publish its audit results later this year.

headline: Kestrel Industries opens new production line in Dayton
body: Kestrel Industries commissioned a new line at its Dayton site, adding capacity for existing customers. Management said the expansion was funded from operating cash flow.
